mapper.select: select a.id, a.sale_status, a.serve_item_id, b.name serve_item_name, b.serve_type_id, c.name serve_type_name, a.region_id, b.reference_price, a.price, a.is_hot, a.create_time, b.update_time from serve a inner join serve_item b on a.serve_item_id = b.id inner join serve_type c on b.serve_type_id = c.id where a.status = 1000 and region_id = #{regionId}
